body.text:
I read this fic since the first chapter and the ending make me cry. The scene when Bluestar not look back at the camp is staying with me, because she choose to go alone even she is scared.

* * *

I think more about what she find. The journey she did many times, but this time maybe StarClan will tell her Oakheart is not waiting for her. That is why she make herself stop thinking of him, I think.
body.background: Warriors is a series of novels about clans of wild cats. Bluestar, a clan leader, once loved Oakheart of a rival clan; this fic retells her last journey to the Moonstone, where leaders meet the spirits of their ancestors.
body.source:
AO3 work "Long Way Home" by mossfur_writes, Chapter 24: The Moonstone.

Bluestar did not look back at the camp. The moor was silver under a moon that had not been there an hour ago, and the cold came up through her paws like an old argument she had never finished. She thought of Oakheart, and then she made herself stop thinking of him, and walked on.

Author's note: That's the end! Thank you for sticking with this for two years. If you have a second, tell me which scene stayed with you, I read every comment.

why.note: scared 后面要接 of 才能说明怕的是什么。原文只写 she's scared，读者会以为她怕独自上路，而作者真正怕的是到了月石才知道的事。这个词本身没错，要补上它的对象。

why.label: chose
why.note: 故事是过去时（didn't look back），所以这里要用过去式 chose。原文 choose 是现在式，和上下文时态不一致。

why.label: learn
why.note: 这里指她在月石上会得知的事，用 learn 比 find 更贴近作者的意思，因为重点是得到的消息，而不是找到东西。下一句会再说明具体是什么，这里只需点出她怕的是得知这件事。

why.note: 句子主语在过去时的叙述里，怕的是将来才会知道的事，所以用 would（缩写 'd）表示过去看来的将来。直接写 will 会打断过去时的叙述。

items.orig: I think more about what she find.
items.final: I think it's really about what she'll find at the Moonstone.

note.meaning: 害怕（某人或某事）；后接说明怕的对象。
note.usage: 说明某人怕的具体对象时使用，后面接名词或 what 从句。只说 scared 时读者会以为是怕一般的事，所以要用 scared of 点明对象，比原句更清楚。

examples.t: Bluestar was scared of what she would learn at the Moonstone.
examples.n: Bluestar 很怕自己在月亮石上会得知的事。

examples.t: I'm scared of dogs, so I cross the street when I see one.
examples.n: 我怕狗，所以看到狗就过马路。

examples.t: Lots of kids are scared of the dark.

s1.orig: The scene when Bluestar not look back at the camp is staying with me, because she choose to go alone even she is scared.
s1.final: The scene when Bluestar didn't look back at the camp is staying with me, because she chose to go alone even though she was scared of what she'd learn at the Moonstone.

note.meaning: 其实主要是关于……；点出真正的重点。
note.usage: 用于说明真正的重点，后面接 what、whether 等从句或名词。原句用 more about 却没有比较对象，读者会不解；加上 really 就能直接点明重点，不必说出比较的另一方。

examples.t: Honestly, it's really about what Bluestar will find, not the journey.
examples.n: 说实话，其实主要是关于 Bluestar 会发现什么，而不是这段旅程。

examples.t: Don't argue about the bill; it's really about who forgot to pay.
examples.n: 别为账单争了，其实主要是谁忘了付钱。

examples.t: Forget the weather. It's really about whether we go or not.
examples.n: 别管天气了，其实重点是我们去不去。
